decisions.rationale: Lead Mega Metagross + Aerodactyl: Metagross walls Floette/Gholdengo and Iron Head OHKOes Floette; Aerodactyl gives Tailwind, Wide Guard vs EQ/Rock Slide/Make It Rain/Dazzling Gleam, and Taunt for Lopunny's Encore. decisions.notebook: Claude's roster: Tyranitar+Excadrill sand core, Mega Floette, Gholdengo, Rotom-Heat, Lopunny support. Game 1 pick: Metagross/Aerodactyl lead, Incineroar+Rotom-Wash back; Mamoswine/Manectric benched. Key facts: (1) Mega Metagross walls Floette (0.5x Fairy) and Gholdengo; Tough Claws Iron Head OHKOes Floette; Jolly 178 outspeeds Floette 144 max. (2) Rotom-Heat is their main Metagross answer (Overheat SE, WoW burns my all-physical attackers) but Levitate makes it immune to Ground — answer it with Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump or Aerodactyl Rock Slide, never EQ/Stomping Tantrum. (3) Sand-rush Excadrill (~280 spe) outspeeds my whole team; counter with Wide Guard (blocks EQ/Rock Slide), Intimidate, Will-O-Wisp. (4) Aerodactyl is Rock-type: immune to sand chip, so Focus Sash survives under sand; Wide Guard also blanks Make It Rain/Dazzling Gleam. (5) Lopunny Fake Out (+3 prio) always beats my turn-1 Tailwind/Taunt — expect one flinch; Aerodactyl 200 outspeeds Lopunny 172 for Taunt afterward to deny Encore/Helping Hand. (6) Incineroar resists Fairy (Dark) and hits Gholdengo SE with Darkest Lariat, but loses the speed race and fears Make It Rain/Shadow Ball. (7) If they bench Rotom-Heat in later games, Mamoswine becomes strong: Life Orb EQ is SE on Ttar/Excadrill/Gholdengo and Aerodactyl/Rotom-Wash are EQ-immune partners. (8) Manectric (172 Timid) outspeeds all their non-sand mons; Snarl punishes their special stack if they go Floette+Gholdengo+Rotom-Heat heavy.

decisions.rationale: Tyranitar sets uncontested sand (nothing on their side sets weather), and Rotom-Heat is the safest partner: Levitate ignores Mamoswine/EQ, resists Metagross's Steel STAB, and Charcoal Overheat is a guaranteed OHKO on Mega Metagross plus a near-KO on Thick Fat Mamoswine. Excadrill comes in as the 216-Speed Sand Rush cleaner (Iron Head OHKOs Aerodactyl through Sash math) once Mamoswine is gone, and Gholdengo covers Rotom-Wash, blocks status, and Make It Rain shreds Mamoswine/Aerodactyl.

decisions.notebook: Claude's roster: Tyranitar+Excadrill sand core, Mega Floette, Gholdengo (Colbur, Good as Gold), Rotom-Heat (Charcoal), Lopunny (Sitrus, Fake Out/Encore/Helping Hand). Game 1 they brought sand core + Rotom-Heat + Gholdengo, benching Floette/Lopunny; Protect-baiting Overheat worked and Rotom-Wash+Incineroar cleaned up. Durable facts: (1) Charcoal Modest Overheat guaranteed-OHKOs Metagross — always Protect-bait or pivot (Rotom-Wash/Incineroar resist); Rotom-Heat is Levitate, answer with Hydro Pump/Rock Slide. (2) Sand Rush Excadrill outspeeds everything; Rotom-Wash (Levitate, resists Iron Head) is the best answer, Hydro Pump 83-157%; Wide Guard/Intimidate/WoW support. (3) Gholdengo: Good as Gold blocks Taunt/WoW; Colbur halves first Dark hit so Flare Blitz > Darkest Lariat from Incineroar; Make It Rain is resisted by both Rotom-Wash (0.25x) and Incineroar (0.5x). (4) Mega Metagross walls Floette and OHKOes with Tough Claws Iron Head; Jolly 178 outspeeds Modest Floette 144. (5) Lopunny Fake Out beats turn-1 Tailwind; Aerodactyl 200 outspeeds for Taunt after. (6) Smooth Rock = long sand; Aerodactyl Rock-type ignores chip under Sash. Game 2: expect Floette/Lopunny adjustments; keep Metagross as Fairy/Gholdengo wall, preserve Rotom-Wash for Excadrill/Rotom-Heat, and don't let Incineroar eat Make It Rain chip before it can fire Flare Blitz.

decisions.rationale: Rotom-Heat is at -2 SpA, so its attacks are near-worthless; its best use is Will-O-Wisp on Incineroar (it outspeeds Incineroar's 80-112 max). Burning Incineroar turns Flare Blitz on Gholdengo from a guaranteed OHKO (110-160%) into ~55-80%, and Colbur already blunts Darkest Lariat to ~39-57%, making Gholdengo the win condition. Nasty Plot converts Shadow Ball into 73-137% vs Rotom-Wash and 63-115% vs Incineroar; Protect only delays a losing 1v2. Fake Out can't touch Gholdengo.
decisions.notebook:
MATCHUP FACTS (verified lvl50, Champions):
- Overheat cuts own SpA by 2: Rotom-Heat is a one-shot nuke, then it is offensively dead. Plan its follow-up as Will-O-Wisp/Protect/chip only. Consider leading Wisp before Overheat if the KO isn't needed immediately.
- Rotom-Heat (Spe 116) outspeeds Incineroar (max 112) but Fake Out (+3) still preempts Wisp.
- Foe Incineroar Flare Blitz vs Gholdengo 110-160% (guaranteed OHKO); Darkest Lariat 79-114% raw but Colbur Berry halves it to ~39-57%. BURNING INCINEROAR is the key to keeping Gholdengo alive; burned Flare Blitz ~55-80%.
- Foe Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump vs Gholdengo 50-74%; Hydro Pump 2x kills our Rotom-Heat; their Rotom-Wash has Leftovers.
- Gholdengo Shadow Ball: vs Rotom-Wash 37-70% (unboosted), 73-137% at +2; vs Incineroar 32-58%, 63-115% at +2. Nasty Plot is Gholdengo's win condition; Good as Gold blanks Wisp/Taunt/Snarl-status, Ghost typing blanks Fake Out.
- Rotom-Heat Charcoal Overheat OHKOs Mega Metagross; 62-120% vs Mamoswine thru Thick Fat. Excadrill LO Iron Head OHKOs Aerodactyl. Sand chips Incineroar/Rotom/Manectric/Aerodactyl, not Excadrill/Gholdengo/TTar.
- Manectric: Lightning Rod + Shuca, never Thunderbolt near it. Aerodactyl has Wide Guard/Tailwind/Taunt, no Protect; kill it before Tailwind.
GAME 2 PLAN: Excadrill+Gholdengo+Tyranitar core; 4th flex. Beware Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump deleting Excadrill and Incineroar Flare Blitz deleting Gholdengo/Excadrill; lead to pressure Incineroar with burn or KO it early.

reflections.summary: Won at team preview and with the turn-1 Protect bait: Rotom-Heat's Charcoal Overheat was neutralized, Mega Metagross's Iron Head broke the sand core by KOing Tyranitar on turn 2, and the Rotom-Wash + Incineroar back end hard-walled everything left — Wash OHKO'd Excadrill and Rotom-Heat with Hydro Pump while both resist Gholdengo's Make It Rain. The opponent's turn-4 Nasty Plot and Will-O-Wisp into burn-immune Incineroar were misplays that only sped up an already-decided endgame.
reflections.adjustment: Expect Floette-Eternal and/or Lopunny in game 2 since both were benched. Stop trading Mega Metagross into Rotom-Heat's second Overheat — after the Protect bait, pivot Rotom-Wash in on the next Overheat so Metagross survives as the Floette/Gholdengo wall (Tough Claws Iron Head, outspeeds Modest Floette).
reflections.notebook: Opponent game-1 bring: sand core (Tyranitar/Excadrill) + Rotom-Heat + Gholdengo; benched Floette-Eternal and Lopunny — expect one or both next game. Tendencies: Rotom-Heat clicks Overheat into Metagross even vs Protect (reliably baitable); Gholdengo plays greedy (Nasty Plot while behind); opponent loses track of immunities under pressure (WoW into Fire-type Incineroar). Confirmed answers: Rotom-Wash (Levitate) is the catch-all for Excadrill and Rotom-Heat, Hydro Pump OHKOing both; Incineroar + Rotom-Wash both resist Make It Rain and Incineroar is burn-immune, so that pair stonewalls Gholdengo/Rotom-Heat — use Flare Blitz, not Darkest Lariat, vs Colbur Gholdengo. Plan: keep Mega Metagross healthy for Floette (pivot Wash into baited Overheats rather than sacking it); if Lopunny leads for Fake Out pressure, Aerodactyl still outspeeds for Taunt from turn 2.

reflections.summary: Lost 2-4 because the four brought were structurally answered by the opponent's back pair. Tyranitar + Excadrill traded evenly with Mega Metagross and Aerodactyl (Overheat OHKO'd Metagross, Iron Head OHKO'd Aerodactyl), but that left our two remaining Pokemon facing an untouched Incineroar + Rotom-Wash core that beats them cleanly: Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump OHKOs Life Orb Excadrill through sand speed and 2HKOs Rotom-Heat, and Flare Blitz OHKOs Gholdengo. Compounding errors of plan (not of tactics): O
reflections.adjustment: Rebuild the bring around the Incineroar + Rotom-Wash core rather than around sand. Do not bring both Tyranitar and Excadrill: Excadrill is a Hydro Pump one-shot and Tyranitar folds to Iron Head/Fighting, so the sand engine costs two slots to answer one Mega. Bring Gholdengo plus an Electric/Grass answer to Rotom-Wash and something that resists Fire, and evolve our Mega Stone holder this game to match their Metagrossite tempo. Concrete piloting rules: (1) never target Incineroar with Will-O-Wisp
reflections.notebook:
MATCHUP FACTS (verified lvl50, Champions):
- CORRECTION: Incineroar is Fire/Dark and CANNOT be burned. Will-O-Wisp on it is a wasted turn. Any plan built on burning Incineroar to preserve Gholdengo is void.
- Foe Incineroar Flare Blitz OHKOs Gholdengo (110-160%); Darkest Lariat is halved by Colbur (~39-57%). Gholdengo has no safe setup turn while a healthy Incineroar is on the field.
- Foe Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump OHKOs Life Orb Excadrill and 2HKOs Rotom-Heat; ~50-74% on Gholdengo. Leftovers Rotom-Wash grinds out long games; it is their most valuable piece and should be removed first.
- Overheat cuts own SpA by 2: Rotom-Heat is one nuke then dead weight. Do not spend it into a likely Protect. Charcoal Overheat OHKOs Mega Metagross and 62-120% vs Mamoswine through Thick Fat, but Incineroar resists Fire.
- Rotom-Heat (116 Spe) outspeeds Incineroar (max 112), but Fake Out (+3) still preempts.
- Excadrill LO Iron Head OHKOs Aerodactyl. Sand chips Incineroar/Rotom/Manectric/Aerodactyl, not Excadrill/Gholdengo/Tyranitar. Sand Rush speed does not save Excadrill from Hydro Pump - it still dies after acting.
- Gholdengo Shadow Ball: vs Rotom-Wash 37-70% (73-137% at +2); vs Incineroar 32-58% (63-115% at +2). Good as Gold blanks Wisp/Taunt/Snarl-status; Ghost blanks Fake Out.
- Manectric: Lightning Rod + Shuca - never Thunderbolt near it. Aerodactyl: Focus Sash, Wide Guard/Tailwind/Taunt, no Protect - remove before Tailwind.
OPPONENT TENDENCIES:
- Leads Mega Metagross + Aerodactyl; Metagross Mega Evolves and Protects on turn 1 while Aerodactyl Taunts our Rotom-Heat.
